name: Bracken Field Seeds: Packing Floor Decisions

concepts.name: Packing Superintendent
passages: The Packing Superintendent may authorize overtime only after the Stock Controller confirms that sealed seed is available.
The Packing Superintendent must approve a change to a printed cultivar name before the Label Clerk issues a revised proof bearing that change.
Approval of a cultivar name change by the Packing Superintendent does not authorize release of a held seed lot.
The Packing Superintendent may cancel a packing order before the Line Lead records the first sealed packet, but must not cancel the order after that record is made.

concepts.name: Stock Controller
passages: The Stock Controller records the received mass of every delivered seed lot.
The Stock Controller must place a seed lot on a moisture hold when its first sample measures more than 8.0 percent moisture.
The Stock Controller may remove a moisture hold only after the Quality Examiner records a moisture result of 8.0 percent or less from a second sample of the same lot.
The Stock Controller must reserve exactly 2 kilograms from each cleared seed lot before assigning any of the remaining seed to a packing order.

concepts.name: Quality Examiner
passages: The Quality Examiner must test a second sample from every seed lot placed on a moisture hold.
The Quality Examiner records moisture results to one decimal place.
A second-sample moisture result of 8.0 percent or less recorded by the Quality Examiner permits the Stock Controller to remove the moisture hold but does not automatically remove that hold.
The Quality Examiner must retain each sample envelope until 30 days after the date that sample was tested.

concepts.name: Line Lead
passages: The Line Lead may start a packing order only after the Stock Controller has removed all holds on its seed lot and the Label Clerk has approved its label proof.
The Line Lead must stop the packing line when a packet with a torn seal is found.
After a stop for a torn seal, the Line Lead may restart the line only after the Seal Inspector records a passed check of a replacement sealing jaw.
The Line Lead records the time of the first sealed packet for every packing order.

concepts.name: Label Clerk
passages: The Label Clerk must compare the cultivar name on each proof with the packing order before approving that proof.
The Label Clerk must keep every superseded proof with the packing order.
A proof approved by the Label Clerk is valid only for the packing order named on that proof.
The Label Clerk must mark a superseded proof as withdrawn before approving its replacement.

concepts.name: Seal Inspector
passages: The Seal Inspector must examine five consecutive packets after a replacement sealing jaw is fitted.
The Seal Inspector may record a passed check of a replacement sealing jaw when all five examined packets have intact seals, and must not record a passed check otherwise.
The Seal Inspector must record a failed check if any of the five examined packets has a split seal.
A passed check recorded by the Seal Inspector does not itself restart the packing line.
